title: Five Café Photos With Music
tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

faults.what: The storefront and latte shots use conspicuous blurred duplicate-image bands above and below the main photo, making the vertical layout less polished.

judge.summary: The output is an approximately 10-second vertical café montage with music, no added text, and a visible dissolve, though the blurred padding is conspicuous.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 is reported as 10.1 seconds long, and its sampled frames are vertical.

must_haves.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The samples show the storefront, latte, pastries dissolving into a barista shot, and finally an interior, consistent with the requested order. However, the original barista and interior attachments are not shown for identity comparison.

must_haves.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must_haves.why: The storefront, latte, barista, and interior are recognizable in the samples, but the pastries are shown only during a dissolve; their clear-screen duration cannot be established.

must_haves.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must_haves.why: The audio report indicates music and no transcribed words, but it does not establish the music's relaxed mood or conclusively exclude singing.

must_haves.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must_haves.why: The pastries-to-barista sample shows a conventional cross-dissolve, and no added text appears in any supplied output frame.
